observations.finding: C4 DacRoiController sets fault bit 8 if trap, non-user privilege, or satp change while ROI running (or ended and busy).
Linux driver declares scope=user_no_trap_one_mm and one context per boot.
Original Streamcluster ROI encloses streamCluster, including stderr writes and output open/write/close. Original ROI must not be moved to hide this.
Canneal/Blackscholes computational ROI may avoid synchronous syscalls, but timer interrupts remain unsupported and have not been validated on DUT.

PACKAGE_RESULT logs current seq/status/full_compare at result queue enqueue. When package_result_waiting is selected, queue bits use saved seq/status. This observer is not a general independent proof of matching for that path.

strict_latency.reason: No proven paired BOOM execution-complete and Rocket full-compare-complete timestamps for same validation unit on a verified common clock; PACKAGE_BEGIN is not BOOM completion.

requirements_before_formal: Resolve or demonstrate handling of original ROI traps/interrupts without changing algorithm, input or ROI.
Validate positive generated/completed/passed counts, zero faults/unmatched tasks, full comparison path, real drain and firmware parked mask.
Do not infer PASS from elaboration, QEMU software execution or guest DONE alone.

limitations: staged IO changes external IO scheduling and preallocates memory; label software profile, do not claim unmodified binary
original file input path still unsupported
asynchronous interrupts and checker execution/drain still unvalidated
